title: Retired Navy pilot's family sees lights in formation over the channel
summary: Tim Gallaudet tells of Retired Navy pilot's family sees lights in formation over the channel, about unspecified at Pacific Palisades, California, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they live in Pacific Palisades and and they've seen they've seen UAP over the channel litted in formation several like white lights clearly operating under intelligent control.

plain: A former Navy admiral, Tim Gallaudet, passes on what a retired Navy pilot and his family told him. According to Gallaudet, the family lives in Pacific Palisades, a coastal part of Los Angeles, and they have seen UAP, the government's newer term for UFOs, over the channel offshore: several white lights flying in formation that, he says, were clearly under intelligent control. If true, it would mean controlled, unknown craft flying near a big American city.
